headline: Texas Preserves 650 Acres of Lake Palestine for New State Park
meta_description: Texas Parks and Wildlife Foundation secures 650-acre family ranch on Lake Palestine, protecting one of the lake's largest undeveloped tracts.
summary_short: A major conservation win: Texas Parks and Wildlife Foundation has acquired a 650-acre family ranch on Lake Palestine to create a new state park.
body:
The Texas Parks and Wildlife Foundation has secured a 650-acre family ranch on Lake Palestine, creating a new state park and protecting one of the lake's largest remaining undeveloped tracts.

The acquisition represents a significant conservation effort to preserve natural shoreline in the region. Lake Palestine, a major recreational destination in East Texas, has faced ongoing pressure from development. This family ranch—one of the few substantial properties on the lake still in private hands—will now remain open to the public through the state park system.

The move reflects a growing commitment to balancing land use with environmental stewardship, ensuring future generations can access and enjoy Texas's natural spaces.
